title: Pets
summary: Hypixel's 87 pets - the Pets menu, levels 1 to 100, stats by rarity and level, pet XP from your skills and the Taming skill.

s.x: Pets
float at your shoulder and give stats. Every one of Hypixel SkyBlock's
87 pets
is in the game (Bee, Ender Dragon, Rock, Golden Dragon...), at the rarities Hypixel has them in, with their stats and abilities. A pet levels from
(the Golden Dragon to 200) as you gain skill XP.
A pet is an item: a head with the pet's face.
Right-click it
to add it to your pets; if you have none out, it's summoned straight away.
25 pets can be crafted
(Bat, Blaze, Chicken, Endermite, Horse, Ocelot, Pigman, Rabbit, Sheep, Silverfish, Skeleton, Spider, Wither Skeleton, Wolf, Zombie and more): find them in the
Recipe Book
by name. A crafted pet starts at level 1. Pets can also be traded on the
Auction House
Open the
Pets
menu from the
SkyBlock Menu
or with
/pets
The pet you have out is on the card at the top.
Put away
sends it back.
Every other pet is in the grid below.
Click
one to summon it (the one out swaps places with it).
Right-click
one to take it back out as an item, to trade or sell.
Hover a pet for everything about it.
The pet you have out floats beside your shoulder, for everyone to see.
A pet's name shows its level:
[Lvl 48] Bee
. Its stats and its abilities' numbers grow in a straight line from level 1 to level 100, and a rarer pet has more of them. Its tooltip shows them at its level, and the progress to the next level.
A rarer pet needs more XP for each level: a Legendary pet starts further up Hypixel's pet XP table than a Common one.
Your summoned pet gets a share of all the skill XP you gain:

rows.x: Its own skill (a Farming pet and Farming XP)
all of it
Its own skill, for a Mining or Fishing pet
one and a half times it
Alchemy or Enchanting
a twelfth
Any other skill
a quarter

s.x: Taming:
whatever your pet gets is also your Taming XP, and every Taming level gives your pets 1% more XP (Zoologist). See
Skills
Right-click a pet item
while a pet is out to give it to that pet. A pet holds one item; the one it held before comes back to you. Its tooltip shows
Held Item
and what it does. Hypixel's pet items work the way their text says:

rows.x: Stats
Big Teeth (+5 Crit Chance), Hardened Scales (+25 Defense), Sharpened Claws (+15 Crit Damage), Lucky Clover (+7 Magic Find), Saddle (+30 Speed), Spooky Cupcake (+30 Strength, +20 Speed)
More of the pet's own stats
Textbook (+100% of its Intelligence), Iron Claws (+40% of its Crit Damage and Crit Chance)
More pet XP
Skill Exp Boosts (+20% to +50% for one skill), All Skills Exp Boosts (+10% to +30% for all)
Rarity
Tier Boost: the pet's stats count as one rarity higher

s.x: A few (Flying Pig, Quick Claw, Exp Share...) show their text but don't work yet.
A pet's abilities work while it's out, with their numbers at its level and rarity (a Tier Boost counts). About a quarter of Hypixel's pet abilities work so far, on 48 of the 87 pets:

rows.x: Stats
Black Cat's Magic Find and Pet Luck, Dolphin's Sea Creature Chance, Squid's Fishing Wisdom, Lion's Damage, Monkey's Foraging Fortune
Stats in a place or at a time

Chicken's Farming Fortune on public islands, Mithril Golem's Magic Find and combat stats on the mining islands, Monkey's Speed and Sweep in The Park, Bal's Pristine in the Magma Fields, Bat's Intelligence and Speed at night
Stats that grow
per player near you (Bee's Hive, Dolphin's Pod Tactics), per skill level (Rose Dragon, Ammonite), per digit of your Gold collection (Golden Dragon)
A share of your stats
Blue Whale's Max Health, Turtle's Defense, Tiger's Ferocity, Ender Dragon's combat stats and Magic Find, Griffin's Strength above 85% Health
Stats from other stats
Elephant's Defense per 100 Speed and Health per 10 Defense, Blue Whale's Defense per 20 Health, Ankylosaurus' Defense as Strength, Golden Dragon's Strength per 5 Magic Find
More damage

Ender Dragon to Ender mobs, Zombie to Undead, Wither Skeleton to Wither mobs, Magma Cube to slimes, T-Rex up close, Giraffe from afar, Megalodon to hurt enemies, Tiger to lone enemies, Pigman to Level 50+ and 100+ mobs, Skeleton's arrows, Golden Dragon per million coins in the bank
Less damage taken
Enderman from Ender mobs, Zombie from zombies, Wolf from wolves, Wither Skeleton from skeletons, Snowman from everything, Turtle under 40% Health

s.x: Abilities for places that aren't in the game yet (the Crimson Isle, the Garden, Jerry's Workshop, the Glacite Tunnels, dungeons) and ones with their own mechanics (Golem's Last Stand, Guardian's Laserbeam, Horse's Stampede, Combat Wisdom towards a mob...) show their text but don't work yet.
Kat
, the pet sitter at a stall in the Hub's market, takes a pet
up one rarity

. Her menu lists your pets with what their next rarity costs: coins, sometimes items (Honey Dippers for a Bee, Summoning Eyes for an Ender Dragon), and a wait (from a minute to weeks, in real time, even while you're offline). Click a pet to give it to her; she looks after
one pet at a time
. When it's ready you get a message; open her menu and click it to take it back at its new rarity (it keeps its XP; its level follows the new rarity's table). All 216 of Hypixel's upgrades are there.
Not yet: the abilities above that don't work yet, Kat Flowers and Bouquets (to skip the wait), and the pets that come from drops, shops and events rather than recipes.
